subject: Project Obsidian kickoff — Cluster-GCN on our entity graphs
body:
Hi Jelena,

Kicking off the Cluster-GCN adoption. We're running this under the internal codename Project Obsidian — use it in channel names and docs.

Why: the retrieval team's entity graph has grown to the point where full-graph GCN training doesn't fit, and neighborhood-sampling approaches are burning GPU-hours. Our Cluster-GCN work (KDD 2019 oral) fixes exactly this: partition the graph with METIS, then train on cluster-induced subgraph batches, which keeps memory bounded and lets us go deeper than 2-3 layers.

Goal (Feb 2 – Apr 13): reproduce the published PPI and Reddit benchmark results to validate the setup, then train on the internal entity graph and hand retrieval a model that beats their sampled-GCN baseline at half the GPU cost.

Jelena — staffing + a quick infra check on METIS in our build, please.

Anders
